fields.name: density
fields.rationale: The density of the mortar is explicitly stated as 1550 kg/m³, which is a key material property for categorizing and comparing different mortars.

fields.name: compressive_strength
fields.rationale: Compressive strength is a critical property for mortars, indicating their load-bearing capacity. It is explicitly provided as ≤ 15 N/mm².
evidence: Compressive strength according to EN 1015-11 ≤ 15 N/mm²

fields.name: thermal_conductivity
fields.rationale: Thermal conductivity is important for understanding the insulation properties of the mortar. It is provided in two ranges based on different conditions.
evidence: Thermal conductivity according to EN 1745 lambda10,dry,mat / P = 50 %: 0.39 - 0.82 W/(mK)
Thermal conductivity according to EN 1745 lambda10,dry,mat / P = 90 %: 0.43 - 0.89 W/(mK)
